name: app.R
content:
# EO snRNA-seq Explorer
#
# Two tabs:
#   1. Gene & signature explorer — search any gene (by symbol or product) and see
#      its per-cluster mean expression light up the UMAP; or build/edit a gene set
#      ("tissue type") and light up clusters by its per-cluster signature score.
#   2. Cluster markers — click a cluster on the UMAP to list its FindAllMarkers
#      markers in a scrollable, searchable table.
#
# All data are precomputed CSVs written by
# bts/data_generation/export_marker_explorer.R and bundled into the app by
# shinylive::export(). No Seurat / expression matrix at runtime — expression is
# shown at per-cluster resolution.

library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

# shinylive::export()'s dependency resolver misses these transitive ggplot2
# deps (scales -> munsell -> colorspace). This unreachable block is still seen
# by shinylive's static scanner, so it forces them into the WASM bundle.
if (FALSE) {
  library(munsell)
  library(colorspace)
}

# --- data -------------------------------------------------------------------
umap    <- read.csv("umap_coords.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
markers <- read.csv("cluster_markers.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                    check.names = FALSE)
gdict   <- read.csv("gene_dict.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
gsets_long <- read.csv("gene_sets.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cm <- read.csv("cluster_mean.csv", check.names = FALSE)
cp <- read.csv("cluster_pct.csv",  check.names = FALSE)
MEAN <- as.matrix(cm[, -1]); rownames(MEAN) <- cm$gene
PCT  <- as.matrix(cp[, -1]); rownames(PCT)  <- cp$gene
colnames(MEAN) <- sub("^c", "", colnames(MEAN))
colnames(PCT)  <- sub("^c", "", colnames(PCT))

# numeric cluster ordering (0, 1, 2, ... not 0, 1, 10, 11)
clust_levels <- as.character(sort(unique(as.integer(umap$cluster))))
MEAN <- MEAN[, clust_levels, drop = FALSE]
PCT  <- PCT[,  clust_levels, drop = FALSE]
umap$cluster    <- factor(as.character(umap$cluster),    levels = clust_levels)
markers$cluster <- factor(as.character(markers$cluster), levels = clust_levels)

# Evidence-based cluster identities. Used to label the markers-tab dropdown;
# the UMAP itself stays numbered so users still assign labels.
cluster_labels <- c(
  "0"  = "Posterior face", "1"  = "Other (progenitor-like)", "2"  = "Anterior face",
  "3"  = "Posterior face", "4"  = "Schwann",                 "5"  = "Stalk (body)",
  "6"  = "Stalk (body)",   "7"  = "Anterior face",           "8"  = "Ribosomal (contamination)",
  "9"  = "Endothelial",    "10" = "Schwann",                 "11" = "Other (unresolved)",
  "12" = "Anterior face",  "13" = "Satellite",               "14" = "Anterior face",
  "15" = "Posterior face", "16" = "Immune",                  "17" = "Stalk (NMJ)"
)
cluster_choices <- setNames(
  clust_levels,
  paste0(clust_levels, " — ", cluster_labels[clust_levels])
)

centroids <- umap |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(U1 = mean(U1), U2 = mean(U2), .groups = "drop")

# predefined gene sets (named list set -> genes)
PRESETS <- split(gsets_long$gene, gsets_long$set)

# selectize choices: search by symbol OR product description
gene_choices <- data.frame(
  value = gdict$gene,
  label = ifelse(nzchar(gdict$product),
                 paste0(gdict$symbol, " — ", gdict$product),
                 gdict$symbol),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
default_gene <- if ("LOC125742960" %in% gdict$gene) "LOC125742960" else gdict$gene[1]

ACCENT <- "#006c95"

# --- signature: mean of per-gene z-scores across clusters -------------------
signature_scores <- function(genes) {
  g <- intersect(genes, rownames(MEAN))
  if (length(g) == 0) return(setNames(rep(NA_real_, ncol(MEAN)), colnames(MEAN)))
  z <- t(apply(MEAN[g, , drop = FALSE], 1, function(r) {
    s <- sd(r); if (is.na(s) || s == 0) r * 0 else (r - mean(r)) / s
  }))
  colMeans(z)
}

# colored UMAP where every cell takes its cluster's value
plot_value_umap <- function(values, legend_title) {
  vmap <- setNames(as.numeric(values), names(values))
  df <- umap
  df$val <- vmap[as.character(df$cluster)]
  ggplot(df, aes(U1, U2, color = val)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(name = legend_title) +
    geom_label(data = centroids, aes(U1, U2, label = cluster), inherit.aes = FALSE,
               fill = "white", alpha = 0.6, label.size = 0,
               fontface = "bold", size = 4) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "right")
}

# per-cluster bar of a value vector
plot_value_bar <- function(values, ylab, pct = NULL) {
  df <- data.frame(cluster = factor(names(values), levels = clust_levels),
                   value = as.numeric(values))
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(cluster, value, fill = value)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
    labs(x = "Cluster", y = ylab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
  if (!is.null(pct)) {
    df$lab <- paste0(round(as.numeric(pct[names(values)]) * 100), "%")
    p <- p + geom_text(data = df, aes(cluster, value, label = lab),
                       inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = -0.3, size = 3,
                       color = "grey30")
  }
  p
}

# =====================================================================
# UI
# =====================================================================
ui <- page_navbar(
  title = "EO snRNA-seq Explorer",
  fillable = TRUE,

  header = tags$style(HTML("
    /* Gene-set pills: wrap long labels and pin the × to the top-right corner */
    .selectize-control.multi .selectize-input > .item {
      position: relative; display: block; white-space: normal;
      word-break: break-word; padding-right: 26px;
    }
    .selectize-control.multi .selectize-input > .item > .remove {
      position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 3px;
      border: 0; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 3px; line-height: 1.4;
    }
    /* Single-gene box: keep the clear × and dropdown caret off the label text */
    .selectize-control.single .selectize-input { padding-right: 46px; }
  ")),

  # ---- Tab 1: Gene & signature explorer ----
  nav_panel(
    "Gene & signature explorer",
    layout_sidebar(
      sidebar = sidebar(
        width = 340,
        radioButtons("mode", "Show",
          c("Single gene" = "gene", "Signature (gene set)" = "sig"),
          selected = "gene"),

        conditionalPanel(
          "input.mode == 'gene'",
          selectizeInput("gene", "Gene (search symbol or description)",
                         choices = NULL,
                         options = list(plugins = list("clear_button"),
                                        maxOptions = 50,
                                        placeholder = "search symbol or description"))
        ),

        conditionalPanel(
          "input.mode == 'sig'",
          selectInput("preset", "Load a predefined set",
                      choices = c("— choose —" = "", names(PRESETS))),
          selectizeInput("set_genes", "Genes in this set (× to remove)",
                         choices = NULL, multiple = TRUE,
                         options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"),
                                        maxOptions = 50,
                                        placeholder = "search to add genes")),
          textInput("set_name", "Name this set", value = ""),
          div(class = "d-flex gap-2 mb-2",
              actionButton("save_set", "Save / update", class = "btn-sm btn-primary"),
              downloadButton("dl_set", "CSV", class = "btn-sm btn-outline-secondary")),
          selectInput("custom", "Your saved sets",
                      choices = c("— none yet —" = "")),
          tags$hr(),
          DT::dataTableOutput("set_table")
        ),

        helpText(
          "Expression is the per-cluster mean of log-normalized RNA (",
          tags$strong("cluster resolution"), ", not per-cell). Signature = mean ",
          "of per-gene z-scores across clusters — a teaching approximation of ",
          tags$code("AddModuleScore"), "."
        )
      ),
      layout_columns(
        col_widths = c(7, 5),
        card(full_screen = TRUE,
             card_header(textOutput("umap_title")),
             plotOutput("expr_umap", height = "100%")),
        card(full_screen = TRUE,
             card_header(textOutput("bar_title")),
             plotOutput("cluster_bar", height = "100%"))
      )
    )
  ),

  # ---- Tab 2: Cluster markers (original explorer) ----
  nav_panel(
    "Cluster markers",
    layout_sidebar(
      sidebar = sidebar(
        width = 320,
        tags$p(tags$strong("Click a cluster on the UMAP"),
               " (or use the dropdown) to see the genes that distinguish it from",
               " all other nuclei."),
        selectInput("cluster", "Cluster", choices = cluster_choices,
                    selected = clust_levels[1]),
        helpText(
          "Markers are positive-only ", tags$code("FindAllMarkers"),
          " results (Wilcoxon, SCT-corrected), sorted by ",
          tags$code("avg_log2FC"), ". ",
          tags$code("pct.1"), "/", tags$code("pct.2"),
          " are the fraction of cells expressing the gene inside vs. outside the cluster."
        )
      ),
      layout_columns(
        col_widths = c(5, 7),
        card(full_screen = TRUE,
             card_header("Harmony UMAP — numbered clusters"),
             plotOutput("mk_umap", click = "umap_click", height = "100%")),
        card(full_screen = TRUE,
             card_header(textOutput("markers_header")),
             DT::dataTableOutput("markers", height = "100%"))
      )
    )
  )
)

# =====================================================================
# server
# =====================================================================
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  updateSelectizeInput(session, "gene", choices = gene_choices,
                       selected = default_gene, server = TRUE)
  updateSelectizeInput(session, "set_genes", choices = gene_choices, server = TRUE)

  custom_sets <- reactiveVal(list())

  # load a predefined set into the working set
  observeEvent(input$preset, {
    if (!is.null(input$preset) && nzchar(input$preset)) {
      updateSelectizeInput(session, "set_genes",
                           choices = gene_choices,
                           selected = PRESETS[[input$preset]], server = TRUE)
      updateTextInput(session, "set_name", value = input$preset)
    }
  })

  # save / update a custom set
  observeEvent(input$save_set, {
    nm <- trimws(input$set_name)
    if (!nzchar(nm)) {
      showNotification("Give the set a name first.", type = "warning")
      return()
    }
    cs <- custom_sets(); cs[[nm]] <- input$set_genes; custom_sets(cs)
    updateSelectInput(session, "custom",
                      choices = c("— none yet —" = "", names(cs)),
                      selected = nm)
    showNotification(paste0("Saved set '", nm, "' (",
                            length(input$set_genes), " genes)."), type = "message")
  })

  # load a saved custom set back into the working set
  observeEvent(input$custom, {
    cs <- custom_sets()
    if (!is.null(input$custom) && nzchar(input$custom) && input$custom %in% names(cs)) {
      updateSelectizeInput(session, "set_genes", choices = gene_choices,
                           selected = cs[[input$custom]], server = TRUE)
      updateTextInput(session, "set_name", value = input$custom)
    }
  })

  output$dl_set <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {
      nm <- trimws(input$set_name); if (!nzchar(nm)) nm <- "gene_set"
      paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "_", nm), ".csv")
    },
    content = function(file) {
      nm <- trimws(input$set_name); if (!nzchar(nm)) nm <- "custom"
      write.csv(data.frame(set = nm, gene = input$set_genes),
                file, row.names = FALSE)
    }
  )

  # current value vector (per cluster) for the active mode
  cur <- reactive({
    if (identical(input$mode, "gene")) {
      g <- input$gene
      validate(need(!is.null(g) && g %in% rownames(MEAN), "Search and pick a gene."))
      sym <- gdict$symbol[match(g, gdict$gene)]
      list(values = MEAN[g, ], pct = PCT[g, ],
           legend = "mean\nlog-norm",
           umap_title = paste0("Expression: ", sym,
                               if (sym != g) paste0(" (", g, ")") else ""),
           bar_title = paste0("Per-cluster mean — ", sym),
           bar_ylab = "Mean log-norm expression")
    } else {
      gs <- intersect(input$set_genes, rownames(MEAN))
      validate(need(length(gs) >= 1, "Add at least one gene to the set."))
      nm <- trimws(input$set_name); if (!nzchar(nm)) nm <- "set"
      list(values = signature_scores(gs), pct = NULL,
           legend = "signature",
           umap_title = paste0("Signature: ", nm, " (", length(gs), " genes)"),
           bar_title = paste0("Per-cluster signature — ", nm),
           bar_ylab = "Signature score (mean z)")
    }
  })

  output$umap_title <- renderText(cur()$umap_title)
  output$bar_title  <- renderText(cur()$bar_title)
  output$expr_umap  <- renderPlot(plot_value_umap(cur()$values, cur()$legend))
  output$cluster_bar <- renderPlot(
    plot_value_bar(cur()$values, cur()$bar_ylab, pct = cur()$pct))

  # member-gene table for the signature mode (read-only; × is on the pills above)
  output$set_table <- DT::renderDataTable({
    gs <- intersect(input$set_genes, rownames(MEAN))
    validate(need(length(gs) >= 1, "No genes in set yet."))
    peak <- clust_levels[max.col(MEAN[gs, , drop = FALSE], ties.method = "first")]
    tab <- data.frame(
      gene = gs,
      symbol = gdict$symbol[match(gs, gdict$gene)],
      `peak cluster` = peak,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
    DT::datatable(tab, rownames = FALSE, selection = "none",
                  options = list(paging = FALSE, dom = "t", scrollY = "180px",
                                 scrollCollapse = TRUE))
  })

  # ---- Tab 2: cluster markers ----
  selected <- reactiveVal(clust_levels[1])

  observeEvent(input$umap_click, {
    hit <- nearPoints(umap, input$umap_click, xvar = "U1", yvar = "U2",
                      maxpoints = 1, threshold = 10000)
    if (nrow(hit) == 1) {
      cl <- as.character(hit$cluster[1]); selected(cl)
      updateSelectInput(session, "cluster", selected = cl)
    }
  })
  observeEvent(input$cluster, {
    if (!identical(input$cluster, selected())) selected(input$cluster)
  })

  output$mk_umap <- renderPlot({
    sel <- selected(); umap$is_sel <- umap$cluster == sel
    ggplot(umap, aes(U1, U2, color = cluster)) +
      geom_point(data = subset(umap, !is_sel), size = 0.7, alpha = 0.25) +
      geom_point(data = subset(umap, is_sel), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.95) +
      geom_text(data = centroids, aes(label = cluster), color = "black",
                fontface = "bold", size = 5, show.legend = FALSE) +
      coord_equal() + guides(color = "none") +
      labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", title = paste0("Selected cluster: ", sel)) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
            plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = ACCENT))
  })

  output$markers_header <- renderText({
    n <- sum(markers$cluster == selected())
    paste0("Markers for cluster ", selected(), " (", n, " genes)")
  })

  output$markers <- DT::renderDataTable({
    tab <- markers |>
      filter(cluster == selected()) |>
      arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) |>
      select(gene, gene_name, product, avg_log2FC, pct.1, pct.2, p_val_adj)
    DT::datatable(
      tab, rownames = FALSE, fillContainer = TRUE,
      colnames = c("Gene", "Symbol", "Product description",
                   "avg log2FC", "pct.1", "pct.2", "padj"),
      selection = "none",
      options = list(scrollCollapse = TRUE, paging = FALSE, dom = "ft",
                     order = list(list(3, "desc")),
                     columnDefs = list(list(width = "45%", targets = 2)))
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
